assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md, Step 1 'Required sections' table lists 'Environment / Version | `### **Environment / Version**` | Yes', and the section is quoted verbatim: '> Not sure which version — using whatever is deployed on staging.' It is followed by a note that the section 'has **no version identifier**... The text is vague ("not sure which version", "whatever is deployed on staging")'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.2 – Extract version from description' quotes the section content and checks three patterns (explicit version number, product-prefixed, version keyword + number), all marked 'No'. It concludes: '**Result: no version can be extracted.** Per 4.5.2, skip 4.5.3 ... 4.5.4 ... and 4.5.5 ... and go straight to **4.5.6 (gap flagging)**.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.6 – Flag gap' shows a simulated jira.add_comment("ACME-511", ...) whose content is the exact text '> Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' The ADF paragraph text node has the same string. task-description.md Bug Context also says 'A gap comment was posted on ACME-511'.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, the gap comment content ends with '---' followed by 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v{version}.' The ADF shape includes a {"type": "rule"} node and a paragraph with the text 'This comment was AI-generated by ', a link-marked 'sdlc-workflow/triage-bug' pointing to https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins, and ' v{version}.'. This matches the Comment Footnote section of plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/triage-bug/SKILL.md (lines 64-106). The output notes that {version} is read from plugin.json at posting time.
